description: This file defines ASN.1 structures and classes for the F1AP protocol used in 3GPP telecommunications, including message types, procedures, and container structures.

classes.name: f1ap_pdu_c
classes.description: Represents the F1AP Protocol Data Unit with choice of message types (init, success, failure, extension).

classes.name: init_msg_s
classes.description: Represents an initiating message with procedure code and associated data.

classes.name: successful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a successful response message with procedure code and associated data.

classes.name: unsuccessful_outcome_s
classes.description: Represents a failure response message with procedure code and associated data.

methods.name: set_init_msg
methods.description: Sets the message type to initiate a message.

methods.name: set_successful_outcome
methods.description: Sets the message type to a successful outcome.

methods.name: set_unsuccessful_outcome
methods.description: Sets the message type to an unsuccessful outcome.

methods.name: set_choice_ext
methods.description: Sets the message to an extension type.
